additional_info.subject: Request to Allow 32-Character idTag Support for Station 170000461 (Delek Katzerin)
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support,
We are currently working with charging station
170000461
(Delek Katzerin), and we've encountered an issue where the station rejects
RemoteStartTransaction
requests due to the
idTag
exceeding the 20-character limit defined in the OCPP 1.6 specification.
However, in other Siemens stations within our network, we’ve successfully applied a configuration override that allows
idTag
s of up to
32 characters
, which enables smooth transaction handling in scenarios where the identifier is generated by third-party OCPI platforms (such as Delek’s system).
We kindly request that you apply the same override or configuration to station
170000461
, so it can also accept 32-character
idTag
values, similar to the other units.
Please let us know if you need any additional information from our side to proceed.
Best regards,
Ziv Vinitzer
